label: Every first being is CORRUPTIBLE_INCORRUPTIBLE_1: it cannot fail to be in being
paraphrase: Open premise, analyst formulation, unattributed: every first being (no being other than it is simply prior to it) is simply incorruptible: it cannot fail to be in the respect of being (esse). Orientation only: Metaphysics Theta.8, 1050b16-19 (the eternal is prior in substance; the necessary beings are first); the pinned reading STMT-INCORRUPTIBLE-IS-IN-ACT-IN-SUBSTANCE covers 1050b16-18 and is not attributed this premise. It says nothing about failing to be in a place, quantity or quality. Its denial is a contingent first being.
